item.title: Getting Started
item.description:
This guide walks you through accessing Haltian Finder and navigating the basic interface.

Accessing Haltian Finder

Login

  1. Navigate to haltian-finder.eu.haltian.io
  2. Enter your credentials:
    • Organization ID - Your Haltian IoT organization identifier
    • Email address - Your user account email
    • Password - Your account password
  3. Click Sign In
Account Access

If you don’t have an account or need to reset your password, contact your organization administrator.
